title: Layerleak local scan record (record_schema_version 2)
description: The one JSON file the CLI writes per scan under --output-dir / LAYERLEAK_FINDINGS_DIR / ./findings. It embeds the public result, a findings array (public fields plus source_location) and the PostgreSQL persistence outcome. It never carries raw secret values.

created_at.description: UTC time the record was written, RFC 3339 with second precision.

result.description: The public result, identical to --format json: scanned_at, duration_ms and scanner (name, version, detector_set_version) date and attribute the scan.

findings.description: Every finding of the scan, actionable first and then suppressed, in its public form.

source_location.description: Where the detector saw the value, for example env:KEY or file:<path>.

status.description: disabled: no database was configured (or --no-db); saved: the scan_runs row was written; failed: the save failed and the error is a neutral code.
